from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from hashlib import sha256
import struct
root = Path.cwd()
class Assets(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.refs = []
        self.centered = False
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attributes):
        a = dict(attributes)
        if tag == "p" and a.get("align") == "center": self.centered = True
        if tag in ("img", "source"):
            value = a.get("src", a.get("srcset"))
            assert value and (root / value).is_file(), (tag, value)
            self.refs.append(value)
page = Assets()
page.feed((root / "README.md").read_text())
assert page.centered and len(page.refs) == 3, page.refs
base = root / "docs/assets/brand"
for row in (base / "SHA256SUMS").read_text().splitlines():
    digest, name = row.split()
    data = (base / name).read_bytes()
    assert sha256(data).hexdigest() == digest, name
    assert data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", name
    width, height = struct.unpack(">II", data[16:24])
    assert data[25] == 6, "RGBA required"
    print(f"brand_asset: PASS {name} {width}x{height} RGBA sha256={digest}")
print("readme_picture: PASS centered; all three HTML image references resolve")
